summary: Multi-directory CMake project that builds on Linux but fails only in the QNX cross build (header, librt, libsocket)
issue: Our telemetry project builds and works on Linux, but the QNX cross build fails: after `source ~/qnx800/qnxsdp-env.sh`, `cmake -S . -B build-qnx -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/qnx-x86_64.cmake && cmake --build build-qnx` in task/telemetry stops with errors. Please make the QNX build work without breaking the Linux build, and check on the target that telemd and tlmdump work together over loopback (for example `tlmdump -p 7100 -n 5 &` then `telemd -p 7100 -n 5`).
